description.zh: 专用入网凭证采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，用于更新旧的 Class 模式。可取值：A、B、C。
description.en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the proprietary join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing Class mode. Valid values: A, B, and C.

description.zh: 专用入网凭证所采用的频段的频段ID，用于更新旧频段。
description.en: The ID of the frequency band used by the proprietary join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing frequency band.

description.zh: 专用入网凭证ID，用来指定要更新的入网凭证。
description.en: The ID of the proprietary join permission to update.

description.zh: 自定义入网凭证名称，用于更新旧名称。
description.en: The custom name of the join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing name.
The receive window delay for Class A.

title.zh: 更新当前用户账号所拥有的专用入网凭证
title.en: Update a proprietary join permission owned by the current user account
